{{Quote|See? I told myself you had a kind face. I'm rarely wrong about these things. The thug's a Wookiee with absolutely no sense of humor. Goes by the name of Chalurrekk, although you can call him Chumpy. He likes that.|Phinea Shantee|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Chalurrekk''', on at least one occasion called '''Chumpy''' by a [[Gender/Legends|woman]] named [[Phinea Shantee]], was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chalurrekk was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
